newsitem.title: USA: Ciampi--No danger of Europe rate rise after U.S..
newsitem.headline: Ciampi--No danger of Europe rate rise after U.S..

text.p: There is no danger of upward pressure on European interest rates from an increase in U.S. interest rates, Italian Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Sunday.
"Economic situtations are different, and in relation to this, market reactions in terms of interest rates differ," Ciampi said in a briefing at the end of the G7 meeting.
Ciampi noted that when the U.S. cut interest rates six years ago, European interest rates did not follow.
"The world is in communication, in communication with reality. Europe did not have the six years of economic expansion the U.S. had," Ciampi said.
